segment.source: ButtonSpinner combines an input-like content area with increment and decrement handles, and supports add-ons, prefixes, suffixes, statuses, sizes, and visual variants.
segment.target: ButtonSpinner combines an entrada-like conteúdo area com increment e decrement handles, e oferece suporte adicionar-ons, prefixes, suffixes, statuses, tamanhos, e visual variantes.
